title: A degree-0 unit orientation is plus or minus evaluation
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let ξ ∈ Λ_0(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P 0 (a continuous linear functional on the space Covector (Euclid P) 0 of 0-covectors, i.e. of continuous alternating maps (ℝ^P)^{Fin 0} → ℝ), and let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q (as frozen in the contract: there is an orthonormal τ : Fin 0 → ℝ^P with span(range τ) = Q such that either ξ(α) = α(τ) for every 0-covector α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for every 0-covector α). Then there is s ∈ ℝ with |s| = 1 such that ξ(α) = s·α(()) for every 0-covector α, where () = (fun i => i.elim0) : Fin 0 → ℝ^P is the empty family.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P 0) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → ∃ s : ℝ, |s| = 1 ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) 0, ξ α = s * α (fun i => i.elim0)
